A personal project I created for my family. Every year, we make a calendar where each family member gets a month. We needed a way to get the photos to a single place easily, and the options available at the time were not as easy for some family members to use. My goal was to build a website with a simple "upload" button where the person didn't need to figure out exactly which folder to put it into—it automatically went there based on their login. Using PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap, and jQuery, I created the space I hadn't found online anywhere else.

I took a style that was previously made for a printed newsletter and faithfully reproduced it on the web. website
Zingerman's Community of Businesses universal website footer

We affectionately call this the ZCoBbar (Zingerman's Community of Businesses navigation bar). It lives on every Zingerman's business footer, and houses all the legal links, along with a full listing of businesses in the 'CoB for easy traversing. I utilized local system fonts and SVGs to make the interface load quickly and look clean. Built with sustainability, accessibility, and fluid screen sizes in mind.
